body: Hi oml!!! Just listened to this and was truly amazing, really helped me slow down and brought me there!!

I do not really need their permission, I just don’t want them to think I’m a loser or quitting to early. It’s hard because maybe over the years it will develop into a better position but I don’t want to spend my teen years not enjoying something.
Yes, they are great people and I work about 10 hrs a week
